questions.q: Where did Baruch write the words of this book?
questions.evidence: AND these are the words of the book, which Baruch the son of Nerias, the son of Maaseas, the son of Sedekias, the son of Asadias, the son of Helkias, wrote in Babylon

questions.q: What did the exiles do when they heard the book read?
questions.evidence: And they wept, and fasted, and prayed before the Lord

questions.q: Why is Israel in its enemies' land, Baruch 3 says?
options: It forsook the fountain of wisdom
questions.evidence: You have forsaken the fountain of wisdom

questions.q: What does Baruch tell Jerusalem to put off?
questions.evidence: Put off, O Jerusalem, the garment of your mourning and affliction, and put on the comeliness of the glory that comes from God for ever

questions.q: Who sent the letter to those led captive to Babylon that ends this book?
questions.evidence: A copy of an epistle, which Jeremy sent to them which were to be led captives into Babylon by the king of the Babylonians, to certify them, as it was commanded him of God
